name: Product tracer bullet
about: One approved complete user outcome with delivery evidence
labels: ''

## Outcome and destination

Name the useful behaviour and link the agreed spec.

## Scope and dependencies

Declare scope, exclusions and native blockers.

## Delivery owner and state

Owner: <stable lane/session>; state: planned.

## Integration agreement

Name contracts/consumers and who verifies the joined behaviour.

## Acceptance cases and verification command

Observable cases, agreed testing seams and exact command. Confirm granularity/dependencies before ready-for-agent.

## Publication and observed acceptance

Target, publication plan, read-back and dated observed acceptance. Keep open until published and verified.
